clips.title: The story
paras: At the Sepulcher, Prove Your Worth begins Dalar Dawnweaver's campaign against the worgen of Silverpine. The Forsaken seek a path south through human and dwarven lands, but feral worgen threaten the road. Their presence leads back to Archmage Arugal.

Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and her dreadlord lieutenant, Varimathras, seek to secure the lands south of Tirisfal Glades, including human and dwarven enclaves. Silverpine Forest lies in their path, but the route is dangerous. Feral Moonrage worgen prowl the pine-covered hills, threatening Forsaken supply lines and forward bases.

Dalar Dawnweaver says the worgen came through the work of Arugal, a disgraced former mage of Dalaran. During the Scourge invasion, Arugal unleashed otherworldly worgen upon Silverpine. He has since claimed Shadowfang Keep, while his feral creations roam the forest. Before Dalar trusts soldiers with a deeper inquiry into Arugal's sorcery, recruits must prove their fighting skill against the nearest Moonrage Whitescalps.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Lady Sylvanas has charged Varimathras with the conquering of the human and dwarven lands to the south.
But that fool, Arugal -- charlatan of Dalaran and now cursed beast of Shadowfang Keep -- let his reckless magic wreak havoc with the strategic stronghold of Silverpine Forest.

I need someone skilled in the ways of combat to help clean up Arugal's mess. Prove yourself to me by killing 5 Moonrage Whitescalps. The wretched beasts can often be found just off the road, down the hill below.

clips.title: Progress
paras: If you wish to prove yourself to me, you must kill 5 Moonrage Whitescalps. Accomplish that task, and I will see to it your skill is put to more worthy assignments.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have served me well, adventurer. It is obvious to me that you will be a worthy aide to me as I prepare to rid Silverpine Forest of Arugal's curse.
